data.name: Spellcasting
data.description: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] A cabalist casts arcane spells and cantrips as a magus. He prepares spells using a spellbook, choosing them from the 6th-level and lower spells from the witch spell list; higher-level witch spells are not on the cabalist's spell list.
